Not using this.

reviews.title: Stay away from this company!
reviews.text:
AVOID THIS COMPANY AT ALL COSTS. I never signed up for a subscription and never authorized any charges, yet I was being billed $9.99 every week. When I contacted Apple, they told me to reach out to WeTransfer. WeTransfer then responded a person named Mila by saying there was “nothing they could do” and sent me right back to Apple.
Charging people for services they never agreed to and then refusing to take responsibility is unacceptable and borderline deceptive. This company shows zero accountability, provides no real customer support, and has no interest in fixing their own billing issues. Save yourself the headache and stay far away. I guarantee these reviews are from their own employees, so many problems from users but yet a lot of positive reviews, stay away!!!
